title: CHGR Human Governance Record
description: Artifact classification: Authoritative representation of one Human Governance Act (CHGR-001 Sec.1-Sec.3). Schema validity of this document proves only that it conforms to the CHGR representation contract -- it never establishes that the represented act was valid, applicable, current, or performed by an authorized human (CHGR-REQ-072, CHGR-REQ-080, CHGR-REQ-090-097). No field on this schema can encode automatic authority: there is no 'is_authoritative' field anywhere in this document, and authority_basis_claimed is explicitly named 'claimed', never 'verified', per CHGR-REQ-182's audit requirement that a verifier distinguish what a record claims from what verification actually confirmed. No interactive session, create/confirm/publish command, or storage/registry exists this increment (Phase 143E) -- this schema exists to represent an artifact deterministically, not to produce one.

decision_subject.description: The specific entity, pilot, contract, or artifact this record concerns (CHGR-REQ-009). Bound at creation time from the governing template's own subject_binding_rule. Not a unique key -- multiple records may reference the same subject over time (e.g. supersession chains).

template_ref.description: The exact Decision Template identity and version in force at Confirmation time (CHGR-REQ-088). Never changes once set.

selected_option_id.description: The human's literal selection from the governing template's closed option set, verbatim and unmodified (CHGR-REQ-019, CHGR-REQ-031). This schema does not verify the value actually appears in the referenced template's options array -- that cross-artifact check is a verification-layer responsibility.

decision_maker_identity_evidence.description: Denormalized summary of the decision-maker's identity evidence at its actual assurance level, so a verifier can determine who made the decision from this record alone (CHGR-REQ-181) without necessarily resolving confirmation_evidence_ref. Must remain consistent with the full evidence in the artifact confirmation_evidence_ref points to; an inconsistency is a verification-layer PROVENANCE_INCOMPLETE finding, not a schema-level rejection.

authority_basis_claimed.description: The governing authority basis this record claims (citing the template's own eligible_authority field and its governing contract clause) -- explicitly a CLAIM, never a verified grant (CHGR-001 Sec.11, CHGR-REQ-096, CHGR-REQ-182). Whether the decision-maker actually held this authority is never determined by this field's mere presence. OPTIONAL (Phase 146D, CHGR-REQ-207): present only when a Decision Template eligible_authority citation resolves to construct it from (CHGR-REQ-199, PEC-REQ-115); correctly and permanently absent, never fabricated, otherwise. Absence SHALL be named in this record's own limitations array (CHGR-REQ-199, CHGR-REQ-208).

rationale.description: Optional, entirely human-authored free text (CHGR-REQ-040, CHGR-REQ-045). Never completed, summarized, or edited by PCAE tooling (CHGR-REQ-035).

conditions.description: Optional, entirely human-authored conditions/limitations text (CHGR-REQ-046). Distinct from the limitations array below, which is PCAE's own disclosure of what verification could not confirm, not the human's own conditions.

assurance_level.description: CHGR-REQ-098. Must not exceed what confirmation_evidence_ref's actual evidence shape supports -- enforced at verification, not schema, since this schema cannot see the referenced artifact's content.

lifecycle_state.description: CHGR-REQ-106/107. No transition command exists this increment; a record fixture may declare any of the eight states for structural-representation testing purposes only.

confirmation_evidence_ref.description: Reference to this record's HumanConfirmationEvidence artifact (CHGR-REQ-070).

provenance_ref.description: Reference to this record's GovernanceRecordProvenance artifact (CHGR-REQ-070, CHGR-REQ-083 through CHGR-REQ-088).

integrity_ref.description: Reference to this record's GovernanceRecordIntegrity artifact (CHGR-REQ-071).

predecessor_record_id.description: Optional. Set when this record supersedes a prior one; carried in the record itself, never inferred from filename or timestamp ordering.

successor_record_id.description: Optional. Set once a later record supersedes this one.

suspension_ref.description: Optional. Present only when lifecycle_state is 'suspended'; references the GovernanceRecordLifecycleEvent recording the suspension act.

revocation_ref.description: Optional. Present only when lifecycle_state is 'revoked'; references the GovernanceRecordLifecycleEvent recording the revocation act.

extensions.description: Controlled additive extension container. SHALL NOT override any normative field above, alter authority semantics, weaken required validation, redefine lifecycle state, create a hidden substantive choice, or create execution capability. Empty object permitted.
